subject: Vendor enrollment kickoff — Acme procurement intake
messages:
From: Jessie Hart <jessie.hart@acme.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding & kickoff — Acme procurement intake

Hi Markus / Laura,

Thanks for agreeing to support the intake for Redwood Inference. We're ready to move Redwood into our procurement pipeline and would like to schedule an initial kickoff so we can:

- Run through your vendor setup form and required docs
- Understand PO & invoicing cadence (lead times, invoice remit, sample PO)
- Align on timeline and success criteria for go-live (internal SLA from Acme side)

I've attached our supplier questionnaire and an example SOW for reference (see "Acme_Supplier_Questions.pdf" and "Initial_SOW_Acme.docx").

Availability this week: Tue 10/12 9:00–11:00 PT, Wed 10/13 13:00–16:00 PT, Thu 10/14 morning. If you can propose a 30–45m slot, we'll invite the procurement and AP stakeholders (Michael Ortiz will own PO issuance).

Quick notes: Acme requires vendor tax + banking info prior to issuing POs; we usually need vendor onboarding completed 5 business days before first invoice.

Thanks,
Jessie Hart
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
Jessie.hart@acme.com
(415) 555-0123

(Attachment: Acme_Supplier_Questions.pdf)

Hi Jessie — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the clear ask and the SOW + questionnaire. We're ready to get this moving.

Proposed slots (30–45m):
- Tue 10/12 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 10/13 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu 10/14 09:00–09:45 PT

Suggested agenda (can trim to 30m):
1) Introductions & owners (Redwood: Markus; Procurement ops: Hannah; Sales/AM: Laura)
2) Walk through Acme onboarding checklist + any gaps
3) PO process and invoicing (what you need from us to issue PO)
4) Timeline & milestones (target go-live, invoicing start)
5) Action items & MAP (mutual action plan: stakeholders, deliverables, dates, success criteria)

I've attached our vendor intake form to accelerate vendor data collection: "Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx". Hannah will own procurement-side follow-ups (tax, banking, W9/equivalent).

If Tue 10/12 10:00 works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read (onboarding form + PO flow).

Thanks — Markus

markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jessie Hart <jessie.hart@acme.com>, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & kickoff — Acme procurement intake

Thanks — looping in a few procurement details so we have clear expectations on the call. A few practical items we should confirm during the kickoff: 

- Required fields in our vendor form: legal name, tax ID (or local equivalent), bank wiring details, remittance email, primary technical contact, and insurance certificate (if applicable).
- PO process: Redwood generates invoices after delivery of first month of usage; standard net-30 unless otherwise agreed. Once we receive your completed onboarding form + signed SOW, we'll create a vendor code and share an initial invoice sample.
- Risk & compliance: If Acme needs SOC2 evidence, we can share the redacted report after an NDA; otherwise we have a standard security questionnaire link (https://drive.google.com/open?id=security-questionnaire).

I've attached a short diagram of our internal PO workflow "PO_Workflow_v1.pdf" to make the handoffs clear in the MAP. On the call we should assign owners and target dates (vendor form returned, SOW signed, vendor code created, first invoice).

One ask for Acme: if possible, share the contact who will approve payments (Michael Ortiz) and any vendor setup SLA expectations — we aim to turn around vendor creation within 3 business days after receiving complete docs.

Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0166

(Attachment: PO_Workflow_v1.pdf)
